This plot is small, and I do not have money to buy fertilizer just for it unless I share a bag with someone, so this season I will use the dung and compost I already have at home. I will plant my own barley seed because that is what I know and what I have kept, and I will do the work with my family. I will not irrigate, and I will not buy chemicals for this plot.
